place.name: Ghirardelli Chocolate Company
place.description: The Ghirardelli Chocolate Company, simply known as Ghirardelli ( GHIRR-ər-DEL-ee), is an American confectioner, wholly owned by multinational confectioner Lindt & Sprüngli. The company was founded by and is named after Italian chocolatier Domenico Ghirardelli, who, after working in South America, moved to California.
